m2_definition.definition: A current rights-cleared Israel Post assignment artifact with explicit source-stated coverage, seven-digit string codes, postal-object types and source validity is reproducibly transformed, published as immutable digest-pinned data and verified through the AGID loader/API. Any included geometry, civic-address or building relation has independent authority, terms and lineage; no polygon or national coverage is presumed.

definition_basis: The existing IL manifest had no named M2 stage. This criterion formalizes its assignment, non-area, privacy, territorial and separately licensed geometry rules without changing its nine hard blockers. Source-stated coverage must be complete for the release's declared scope; a street list cannot substitute for licensed postal assignments.

reference_probes.edition: 2025-08-30 only if directly retrieved and verified; search-index text is not a retained current licence snapshot
10/2022; one page visually reviewed as format and routing reference only

street_probe.grain: One resource-version-local street row. Locality code plus street code is the comparison key, not street code alone; _id is an observation-local row key, not a durable civic-address identity.
street_probe.rights: Metadata license fields and the portal's default licence must be reviewed together; an empty item licence is not itself a ban or grant. Bounded public data profiling does not clear production redistribution rights.
street_probe.download_policy: Do not follow the bulk CSV download or API-provided next links. Never retrieve recipient, population, owner or private-address datasets. Persist aggregate quality receipts only.

quality_rules: Validate exact resource and five-field schema; reject additional postcode, premise, coordinate, recipient or owner columns instead of silently exposing them.
Preserve numeric transport types and code string identity without padding; locality/street identifiers are never seven-digit postal assignments.
Measure missingness, invalid types, duplicate row IDs, composite-key duplicates, repeated street codes across localities and code/name inconsistencies within the sampled window.
Record code 9000 and equal street/locality labels as observed diagnostics only; do not invent undocumented sentinel semantics or house numbers.
A reported total, sorted sample and stable repeat do not establish a full or atomic snapshot. Metadata modified dates do not become assignment validity.
No inferred postal geometry, country boundary, civic-address, building, coordinate or AGID relation is emitted from street rows.
